data.one_liner: Core Flutter SDK for Stream Chat providing business logic and controllers without UI.
data.what_it_does: It supplies controllers for channels, messages, users, polls, drafts and more, handling pagination and state management. Utilities like BetterStreamBuilder and LazyLoadScrollView help build custom chat interfaces on top of the Stream Chat client.
use_when: You need a fully custom chat UI and want to manage chat state yourself
You want lightweight core functionality without the UI bundle of stream_chat_flutter
You require pagination, draft handling, and other chat‑specific controllers
You prefer minimal dependencies and platform‑agnostic setup
avoid_when: You want ready‑made chat widgets and UI out of the box
You are not using Stream Chat as the backend
You need a generic state‑management solution unrelated to chat
strengths: Comprehensive set of chat‑specific controllers and utilities
Easy to integrate with the low‑level stream_chat client
weaknesses: Only useful with Stream Chat backend
No UI components, so you must build all widgets yourself
Requires understanding of its controller APIs
